main_text.p: ἐκαλέσγνώσιον, καὶ ὑβεῖν τῆ π[?]αιδείᾳ ἀναπολόγι[?]ᾳ τὸν, τὸτ' αὐτὸ ἡβουλήθη ὁμολογίαν ὁμοίως ἔχθε[?] πρὸς τὴν Ἐκκλησίαν ἐκείνῳ, ὅπ σύμφωνα πάντη λέγειν [?] δια[?]νομὴν τῷ ἀφωρισμένῳ ὑπ' αὐτῆς γ[?]ῆς δι[?] τινας ἀμφιβάλλοντας ἐπὶ τῆς τὸ πνεῦμα ἐκπρόσωσιν. καὶ δὲ τὸ κοινῶν μὴ ἐξ ἴσης ὅτι παντὸς ἐκείνῳ τὸ φανόμενον.
Καὶ μηδένα λόγον τῆς ἐν τῷ συμβόλῳ προσθήκης πιστέυομεν. Τῇ δ' ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ οὐδὲν ἡ ψυχὴ τὰ τῆ χρίσματος ἱστορῆ[?].

Necessario sciendum est, has vltimas duas Actiones sextam nempe & septimam confiftas esse ab ipso Photio, & non re ipsa celebratas. Hocque manifestum fit, ex Synodi ipsius fine, & ab ipsa exposita definitione subscriptionibus eorum, qui in dicta Synodo conuenerant, subsignata. Cum enim quam maxime verfipellis vir hic esset, & ad comminiscendas fraudes aptissimus, cum intenderet demonstrare, tentati a se schismatis aduersus sanctissimam Catholicam, & Apostolicam Romanam Ecclesiam causam, non absque ratione fuisse, in Symbolo nempe fidei additionem, quae etiam ex Filio procedere Spiritum asserebat, ac si illa veluti inusitata cum errore addita fuisset; suspicabatur vero, si verbum de ea fecisset, dum adhuc celebraretur Synodus, Legatos e veteri Roma missos, qui Synodo praesidebant, conturbandos fore, & praeterquam quod ipse non potuisset ostendere, quod vellet, impe-di-

page.notes: The Greek lines are only partly legible at this scan resolution. Words marked [?] are best readings. The Greek is transcribed with uncertain letters flagged rather than completed. The final word of the page is broken as "impe-di-" at the line end, and the hyphen is kept as printed. The left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted.
